engine: Python sqlite3; bundled Rust engine separately covered by integration test

target_claim.sql: SELECT delivery_id FROM deliveries WHERE workspace='w' AND target_id='t1' AND state='pending' AND resolution IS NULL AND due_ms<=10000 ORDER BY due_ms,rowid LIMIT 1
plan: SEARCH deliveries USING INDEX delivery_target_pending (workspace=? AND target_id=? AND due_ms<?)

strict_predecessor.sql: SELECT 1 FROM deliveries WHERE workspace='w' AND target_id='t1' AND rowid<100 AND state<>'submitted' AND resolution IS NULL LIMIT 1
plan: SEARCH deliveries USING INDEX delivery_unresolved_target (workspace=? AND target_id=? AND rowid<?)

expired_lease.sql: SELECT delivery_id FROM deliveries WHERE workspace='w' AND state='sending' AND lease_until_ms<=100
plan: SEARCH deliveries USING INDEX delivery_expired (workspace=? AND state=? AND lease_until_ms<?)

route_ready.sql: SELECT source,event_id FROM routing_tasks WHERE workspace='w' AND state IN ('ready','retry_wait') AND due_ms<=10000 ORDER BY due_ms,event_id LIMIT 100
plan: SEARCH routing_tasks USING INDEX routing_ready_order (workspace=? AND due_ms<?)

audit_retention.sql: SELECT rowid FROM audit WHERE workspace='w' AND occurred_ms<=10000 ORDER BY occurred_ms LIMIT 100
plan: SEARCH audit USING COVERING INDEX audit_retention (workspace=? AND occurred_ms<?)

payload_retention.sql: SELECT rowid FROM retired_work WHERE workspace='w' AND payload_purged=0 AND retired_ms<=100 LIMIT 100
plan: SEARCH retired_work USING COVERING INDEX retired_payload_due (workspace=? AND retired_ms<?)

content_retry_delete.sql: SELECT id FROM content_objects WHERE state='deleting' ORDER BY created_ms LIMIT 100

content_expired_staging.sql: SELECT id FROM content_objects WHERE state IN ('uploading','staged') AND created_ms<100 ORDER BY created_ms LIMIT 100

content_reverse_reference.sql: SELECT event_id FROM event_content WHERE content_id='c1'

checkpoint.sql: SELECT revision,cursor FROM source_checkpoints WHERE workspace='w' AND source='s' AND partition='p'
plan: SEARCH source_checkpoints USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_source_checkpoints_1 (workspace=? AND source=? AND partition=?)
